mutation_alias_contract.canonical_solve: Inputs unchanged; scalar/string or fresh list output; no aliased input return

numeric_complexity_contract.algorithm: Monotone deletion stack: remove a larger top before next smaller letter iff another copy survives or remains unread; after scanning remove deletable trailing copies to minimize prefix length. O(n) time/O(n) space.
numeric_complexity_contract.numeric: Letter counts<=100000; ASCII lex comparison; exactstring. Does not impose exactlyone-per-letter.

problem_contract.objective_summary: New original source-exposed candidate; imported inventory unknown; no global missing, qualification, adoption or held-out claim

return_domain.comparison_policy: exact top-level type and value, no coercion

statement_constraints_snapshot.summary: lowercase string length1..100000; may delete any occurrence whose current letter frequency>=2; retain at leastone of each original letter; lexicographically least feasible subsequence may retain duplicates

problem_contract.title: Lexicographically Smallest String After Deleting Duplicate Characters
